description: FM Moneyball exports omit advanced metrics for some leagues. Those columns export as 0 rather than blank. FMScouter detects this pattern and excludes the affected metrics from percentile averages.

detection.summary: Full limited tracking when every advanced probe column is zero. Partial tracking when some probes are non-zero but other advanced metrics are still zero — those zero columns are excluded individually.

universal_metrics.summary: Tracked in all leagues that provide any match stats in the export (always scored when present).

limited_tracking_unavailable.summary: Never populated for limited-tracking leagues; excluded from percentile averages when the detection pattern matches.
